title: Sekine's Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Keiichiro Sekine, 30, is a handsome, capable office worker who feels he has lived 'out of focus': passive, insensitive and good at everything without passion (JManga blurb via AniList, MAL). He takes up knitting at a small handicrafts shop and slowly falls for Sara, the owner's granddaughter, while repressed memories from his school years resurface (AniList blurb; MangaUpdates). It ran in an adult-oriented josei/seinen magazine, Manga Erotics F.
life_message: Facing past harm and learning to want something for oneself can open the way to real love.

content.note: Past abuse is backstory, shown in brief memory fragments (MAL reviewers).
Past sexual abuse of the lead is listed by MangaUpdates; MAL reviewers confirm trauma shown in fragments but do not specify. Nudity (AniList, MangaUpdates). Capped at 3 (to verify).
Depression, repressed memories, psychological trauma (MangaUpdates); trauma central per MAL reviews.
